title: Mapping global yields of four major crops at 5-minute resolution from 1982 to 2015 using multi-source data and machine learning.
summary: Nature full text establishes country/crop machine-learning models and the GlobalCropYield5min result dataset with repeated model selection and gridded yield validation. The study does not establish external generalization, causal effects or sustained operational impact.
ai_technology: RF, XGBoost and LightGBM models are trained per country/crop and selected by repeated predicted R2/RMSE before gridded estimation.
organization: School of National Safety and Emergency Management, Beijing Normal University, Beijing, 100875, China

evidence.tested: The study produces 5-arc-minute 1982–2015 crop-yield maps with reported performance and dataset comparisons.
evidence.unknown: Fifty repeated runs, administrative and field-scale checks, and comparisons with SPAM/GDHY support the bounded data-product result.
evidence.ai_role: RF, XGBoost and LightGBM models are trained per country/crop and selected by repeated predicted R2/RMSE before gridded estimation.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
